use default

use RANGE = (low: double, high: double)

normalised(bounds: RANGE) -> RANGE =>
    if bounds.low <= bounds.high then
        bounds
    else
        (low = bounds.high, high = bounds.low)
    fi

by_lower_bound(left: RANGE, right: RANGE) -> int =>
    if left.low < right.low then
        -1
    elif left.low > right.low then
        1
    else
        0
    fi

consolidate(ranges: List[RANGE]) -> List[RANGE] is
    let sorted = ranges |> map(normalised) |> sort(by_lower_bound) |> collect()
    let merged = LIST()

    for bounds in sorted do
        if merged.count > 0 /\ bounds.low <= merged[merged.count - 1].high then
            let last = merged[merged.count - 1]

            if bounds.high > last.high then
                merged[merged.count - 1] = (low = last.low, high = bounds.high)
            fi
        else
            merged.add(bounds)
        fi
    od

    return merged
si

show(ranges: List[RANGE]) -> string =>
    ranges
        |> map(bounds => "[{bounds.low}, {bounds.high}]")
        |> join(", ")

let inputs = [
    [(low = 1.1D, high = 2.2D)],
    [(low = 6.1D, high = 7.2D), (low = 7.2D, high = 8.3D)],
    [(low = 4.0D, high = 3.0D), (low = 2.0D, high = 1.0D)],
    [
        (low = 4.0D, high = 3.0D), (low = 2.0D, high = 1.0D),
        (low = -1.0D, high = -2.0D), (low = 3.9D, high = 10.0D)
    ],
    [
        (low = 1.0D, high = 3.0D), (low = -6.0D, high = -1.0D),
        (low = -4.0D, high = -5.0D), (low = 8.0D, high = 2.0D),
        (low = -6.0D, high = -6.0D)
    ]
]

for input in inputs do
    write_line("{show(input)} -> {show(consolidate(input))}")
od
